The code statements that fix the bug are:

if (UserGroupInformation.isSecurityEnabled() &&

    !actualUgi.hasKerberosCredentials()) {
```

This prevents the use of the login user in cases where the actual user should be authenticated properly, thereby ensuring that only users with the required credentials can access KMS operations, thus fixing the authorization issues.
